# Warlock AI Openai

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-openai`

> OpenAI SDK adapter for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [ai-openai](@warlock.js/ai-openai/skills/SKILL.md): OpenAI and compatible endpoints for Warlock AI: `OpenAISDK`, `OpenAIEmbedder`, `OpenAIImageModel`, `kimiSearchTool`, `kimiFetchTool` and pricing registries. Use for "connect OpenAI", Responses or Chat Completions, reasoning, caching, embeddings, images, speech, transcription or Kimi search. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents; @warlock.js/ai-anthropic for Claude; @warlock.js/ai-ollama for local Ollama.
